old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a frying pan on a stovetop, filled with a gently simmering liquid that appears to be oil or butter. The surface of the liquid is active with small bubbles forming and rising to the top, indicating that it is being heated. The pan itself has a white interior with a brown rim and metal rivets along the edge. The stovetop beneath the pan is black, and part of another pot can be seen in the background, suggesting a kitchen setting. The lighting is bright, highlighting the shimmering surface of the liquid and the texture of the pan's interior. There are no visible characters or animals in the scene, and the focus remains solely on the cooking process. The video maintains a steady shot throughout, emphasizing the simmering activity within the pan.

caption: The video captures a white-interior frying pan with a reddish-copper exterior and metal rivets resting on a black stovetop, holding a shallow pool of pale yellowish liquid. Irregular patches of white foam float across the surface, one near the left of center and another along the right side. As the excerpt unfolds, these foam patches slowly deform and reshape in place, their soft outlines shifting from frame to frame rather than sliding across the pan. Small bubbles intermittently form and pop along the lower edge and within the yellowish fluid, marking a gentle simmer. The liquid itself shows faint internal swirling, with bright specular highlights drifting as the surface moves. The pan and background stay fixed, and the camera holds a steady close view. The only visible activity is this quiet, ongoing heating of the frothy liquid.
